name: Doctor's Case
descriptionTemplate: At the start of the turn, if HP is below 50%, Temporary DMG Amplification +[Arg1]%. If HP is below 25%, draw [Arg2] additional cards and gain [Arg2] Arithmetica.
lore:
A briefcase symbolizing the identity of a doctor, very heavy.
Opening it does not guarantee it belongs to a true doctor.
